course_name_en: Aviation Propulsion - Structure, Test and Certification

learning_outcomes.text: Plan, conduct, and derive relevant performance and consumption data from ground test runs of aviation propulsion systems.
Outline designs and future development trends of engine inlets, combustion chambers, and thrust nozzles.

Evaluate designs and design principles for engine subsystems such as fuel, lubrication, sealing, control and regulation systems, as well as bearings and electrical and hydraulic power generation on the engine.
Evaluate aviation fuels, including synthetic fuels and electric propulsion systems.
Plan, conduct, and evaluate certification tests for aviation propulsion systems.
Assess emissions from aviation propulsion systems and identify potential for improvement.

syllabus_topics: Planning, execution, and evaluation of a ground test run regarding performance and consumption
Design principles for engine inlets, combustion chambers, and thrust nozzles
Design principles for engine subsystems such as fuel, lubrication, sealing, control and regulation systems, as well as bearings and electrical and hydraulic power generation on the engine
Certification regulations for aviation propulsion systems
Certification tests for aviation propulsion systems
